pull.title: Retry failed order syncs and email a daily failure digest
pull.body: Order syncs that hit a Shopify error used to sit in errored forever. This retries them with backoff, gives up after five attempts, emails shop owners a daily digest of what failed, and adds a Retry button in the admin.

@@ -1,9 +1,17 @@ class OrderSyncJob < ApplicationJob
 class OrderSyncJob < ApplicationJob
   queue_as :shopify
 
+  retry_on ShopifyClient::RateLimited, wait: :polynomially_longer, attempts: 3
+
   def perform(order_sync_id)
     sync = OrderSync.find(order_sync_id)
     sync.sync!
   rescue ShopifyClient::Error => e
-    sync.update!(status: :errored)
-    Sentry.capture_exception(e)
+    sync.record_failure!(e)
+    if sync.retrying?
+      self.class.set(wait: backoff(sync.attempts)).perform_later(sync.id)
+    end
+    Sentry.capture_exception(e) if sync.failed?
   end

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+class FailureDigestJob < ApplicationJob
+  queue_as :mailers
+
+  def perform
+    Shop.joins(:order_syncs).merge(OrderSync.failed_since(24.hours.ago)).distinct.find_each do |shop|
+      syncs = shop.order_syncs.failed_since(24.hours.ago).includes(:order)
+      SyncMailer.with(shop:, syncs: syncs.to_a).failure_digest.deliver_later
+    end
+  end
+end
